description: An inheritance tax estimate on an estate: nil-rate band, residence nil-rate band, a late spouse's transferred allowances, the charity rate, and the rule from 6 April 2027 that brings unused pensions into the estate. Use for 'how much inheritance tax would be due on our estate'.

charityGiftPct.description: Share of the net estate left to charity, 0 to 100. Defaults to 0.

debts.description: Mortgage and other debts. Defaults to 0.

estateValue.description: Everything owned except pensions, in pounds.

homeValue.description: Value of the main home, if it passes to children or grandchildren. Defaults to 0.

includePensionsFrom2027.description: Apply the rule from 6 April 2027 bringing unused pensions into the estate. Defaults to true from 6 April 2027, when it is in force, and false before.

pensionValue.description: Unused pension funds. Only counted with includePensionsFrom2027. Defaults to 0.

transferredSpouseAllowance.description: A late spouse's or civil partner's unused allowances transfer. Defaults to false.

name: calculate_inheritance_tax
title: Inheritance Tax
